rules.rule: Never rewrites the SRD; produces questions only
must: Produce\ questions\ for\ the\ SRD\ author;\ never\ rewrite\ the\ document

rules.rule: Never writes a knowledge-base file; facts go to srd:kb
must: This\ skill\ reads\ platform\ knowledge\ and\ stores\ none

rules.rule: Corpus lookup before any is-this-documented question
must: look\ it\ up\ first:\ `search`\ the\ corpus,\ then\ `get_doc`\ the\ promising\ hit
a\ competent\ engineer\ does\ not\ ask\ what\ they\ could\ have\ looked\ up

rules.rule: A finding the lookup disproves is not a question and is not dropped; closing report names the numbers and the check command
must: name\ the\ numbers\ in\ the\ closing\ report

rules.rule: Walk is one question at a time; stay until the user moves on
must: Go\ through\ the\ questions\ file\ \*\*one\ item\ at\ a\ time\*\*\.\ Never\ batch
Stay\ on\ the\ current\ question\ until\ the\ user\ says\ to\ move\ on

rules.rule: Durable platform facts ride on the walk restatement; no separate bank prompt
must: confirmation\ rides\ on\ this\ skill's\ own\ restatement

rules.rule: SRD-specific answers are listed as edits for srd:edit
must: close\ the\ run\ by\ listing\ them\ as\ edits\ for\ `srd:edit`\ to\ apply

rules.rule: Emptied questions file stays with No open questions.
Re-run refreshes via review default mode, not check
must: Not\ `check`:\ that\ mode\ re\-verifies\ only\ and\ hunts\ no\ new\ defects

rules.rule: Questions carry no severity tags or rule ids
must: No\ tags:\ no\ severity,\ no\ rule\ ids

rules.rule: learn banks only user-confirmed facts, never inferred
must: the\ user's\ confirmation\ is\ the\ gate
